scripts.build: pnpm exec vite build && pnpm run check:bundle && pnpm exec tsc --build
scripts.check:bundle: pnpm --filter @codemem/core build && node --test scripts/assert-worker-bundle-clean.test.mjs && rm -rf ../../.tmp/cloudflare-coordinator-worker-bundle && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir ../../.tmp/cloudflare-coordinator-worker-bundle && node scripts/assert-worker-bundle-clean.mjs ../../.tmp/cloudflare-coordinator-worker-bundle
scripts.test:node: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts src/index.test.ts
scripts.test:worker: pnpm run check:bundle && pnpm run test:node && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/worker.integration.test.ts
